title: (-)-Epicatechin metabolites as a GPER ligands: a theoretical perspective.
authors: Avila-Aviles, Rodolfo Daniel; Bahena-Culhuac, Erick; Hernandez-Hernandez, J Manuel
one_liner_zh: 该文研究表儿茶素代谢物与GPER受体的结合，属于小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Diet habits and nutrition quality significantly impact health and disease. Here is delve into the intricate relationship between diet habits, nutrition quality, and their direct impact on health and homeostasis. Focusing on (-)-Epicatechin, a natural flavanol found in various foods like green tea and cocoa, known for its positive effects on cardiovascular health and diabetes prevention. The investigation encompasses the absorption, metabolism, and distribution of (-)-Epicatechin in the human body, revealing a diverse array of metabolites in the circulatory system. Notably, (-)-Epicatechin demonstrates an ability to activate nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) through the G protein-coupled estrogen receptor (GPER). While the precise role of GPER and its interaction with classical estrogen receptors (ERs) remains under scrutiny, the study employs computational methods, including density functional theory, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations, to assess the physicochemical properties and binding affinities of key (-)-Epicatechin metabolites with GPER. DFT analysis revealed distinct physicochemical properties among metabolites, influencing their reactivity and stability. Rigid and flexible molecular docking demonstrated varying binding affinities, with some metabolites surpassing (-)-Epicatechin. Molecular dynamics simulations highlighted potential binding pose variations, while MMGBSA analysis provided insights into the energetics of GPER-metabolite interactions. The outcomes elucidate distinct interactions, providing insights into potential molecular mechanisms underlying the effects of (-)-Epicatechin across varied biological contexts.
abstract_zh: 饮食习惯与营养质量对健康和疾病具有显著影响。本文深入探讨了饮食习惯、营养质量及其对健康和体内稳态的直接复杂关系。重点关注(-)-表儿茶素 ((-)-Epicatechin)，一种天然黄烷醇，存在于绿茶和可可等多种食物中，以其对心血管健康和糖尿病预防的积极作用而闻名。研究涵盖了(-)-表儿茶素在人体内的吸收、代谢和分布，揭示了循环系统中多种多样的代谢产物。值得注意的是，(-)-表儿茶素显示出通过G蛋白偶联雌激素受体 (GPER) 激活内皮型一氧化氮合酶 (eNOS) 的能力。尽管GPER的确切作用及其与经典雌激素受体 (ERs) 的相互作用仍在研究中，本研究采用计算方法，包括密度泛函理论、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，以评估关键(-)-表儿茶素代谢产物与GPER的理化性质和结合亲和力。DFT分析揭示了代谢产物间不同的理化性质，影响其反应性和稳定性。刚性及柔性分子对接显示了不同的结合亲和力，其中一些代谢产物超过了(-)-表儿茶素。分子动力学模拟突出了潜在的结合姿态变化，而MMGBSA分析则提供了对GPER-代谢产物相互作用能量学的见解。研究结果阐明了不同的相互作用，为理解(-)-表儿茶素在不同生物学背景下效应的潜在分子机制提供了见解。
